text:
maria (PM): morning — dropping the latest mock for Alerting SLO UI tweaks. main asks: 1) threshold presets vs freeform, 2) notification-channel badging in the preview, 3) suppression preview and keyboard flow. https://figma.redwood/alerts/thresholds (mock)
ajay (Design): looks great. quick thoughts: presets are helpful for novices but we should let advanced users type exact values. maybe a toggle: Preset | Custom. presets need accessible labels (e.g., 'Low latency (p50 < 200ms)').
kevin (Eng): fwiw, presets are easy client-side. the preview render for channel badges currently fetches channel icons from external service — that's the expensive part. can we use initials/svgs first and lazy-load full icons? also we should debounce preview changes by 400ms to avoid a flood of preview renders.
mar ia (PM): @kevin typo on my name? :) but agreed — lazy-load icons. also think about semantics: users often expect channel badges to show who will actually be notified (email, Slack, PagerDuty). how will we show multiple recipients? stacked pills or a count + hover? 
ajay (Design): stacked pills gets messy when there are >3 channels. proposal: show first two pills + "+N" pill and hovering expands tooltip with full list. in the preview area add an affordance: "simulate notification" which opens a quick modal showing the payload sample.
kevin (Eng): for the simulate modal let's reuse the existing notif-preview microservice. sample payload (for design):
```
{
  "alert_id": "AL-1234",
  "threshold": "p95 > 1.2s",
  "notifiers": ["#infra-alerts", "pd:team-pager"],
  "summary": "High tail latency for inference"
}
```
ajay (Design): that payload is perfect for copy/content. UI copy suggestions: replace "suppression" label with "silences" in the inline list, users kept asking 'is that a snooze?'. also add a short helper text under the suppression control: "Silences prevent notifications but keep incidents open for history." 
tabitha (A11y): small but important: pills need 4.5:1 contrast against their background and a visible focus ring for keyboard users. the +N pill must be reachable by keyboard and announced as "expand list of notification channels, N more" — use aria-expanded on the control. also ensure the simulate modal has role=dialog and focus trap.
ajay (Design): agreed. for the pill colors let's use tokens: `--color-badge-bg` and `--color-badge-fg`. tentative CSS example for focus ring:
```
.notification-pill:focus {
  outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
```
maria (PM): one more on thresholds: product asked for "preset severity levels" mapped to SLO impact. Proposal: Preset dropdown with labels: Info / Warning / Critical. each maps to default pXX values but can be overridden. Ajay: show the mapped pXX inline next to label (e.g., Critical — p95 > 1.5s).
kevin (Eng): caution: storing both preset id and custom value needed to avoid losing overrides. backend: expose fields `preset_id` and `explicit_threshold` in the API. minimal schema we can show teams later:
```
{ "preset_id": "critical_v1", "explicit_threshold": "p95>1.5s" }
```
ajay (Design): UX nit: when user types a custom threshold we should show a small toast/inline hint: "Using custom value — will no longer follow 'Critical' preset" with an undo action. keeps mental model clean.
tabitha (A11y): keyboard path for threshold editing: Tab to preset dropdown, arrow keys to pick, Enter to apply. when switching to Custom, focus should move to the numeric input and announce "editing custom threshold".
maria (PM): checklist before we ship this iteration:
- [ ] presets toggle and labels copy (ajay)
- [ ] channel pill clipping + +N expansion (ajay + kevin)
- [ ] simulate notification modal (kevin)
- [ ] accessibility focus/announce behaviours (tabitha)
- [ ] backend schema support for preset + explicit (kevin)
- [ ] helper copy for "Silences" (ajay)
ajay (Design): I'll iterate on the mock and push a variant with the +N behaviour and the helper copy. tagging @design-bot to generate a screenshot diff when I push.
design-bot: generated visual diff: https://images.redwood/diff/1768904321-01.png :eyes:
kevin (Eng): small engineering constraint: the real-time timeline preview (incident open/close history) is expensive to compute. propose we show a static example timeline in the initial release and surface a "Live preview" badge for the future. can we add that to the copy? ajay: yep — add small muted label 'Live preview coming soon'.
mar ia (PM): thanks all — pushing to design review on Friday. if anyone has blocking concerns post them here. :thumbsup:
